name: Secrets in Logs
attack_scenario: a credential or sensitive datum is written to logs, which are widely readable (aggregators, support tooling, shipped to third parties) and long-lived — anyone with log access gains the secret
negative_test_hint: log in with the canary password "canary-P@ssw0rd-9f3b" and grep the logs to assert the value never appears

exemplar.explanation: never log secrets or full PII; log a non-sensitive identifier and redact the rest
